question:
Select the option figure that will replace question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7086147fc4d6955ca5bf4e2b8af2feedafc81a4dda32b3fc5b962f4e23e66194.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is :

 
• Sides of outer polygon in circle i.e. middle polygon side reduced by one.
 
• ***Outer polygon is moving from top to bottom in each step.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82629b857ba34989e2fe007172272167bcdf339e9a52b5ca490044c4d743aea7.png] 

 
• Sides of inner polygon in circle i.e. small polygon side increased by one.
 
• Inner polygon is moving from bottom to top inside outer polygon in each step.</stro
